statements.quote: We anticipate making capital expenditures of approximately $115 billion to $135 billion in 2026 to support our AI efforts and core business.
statements.notes: Total capex guidance covering both AI efforts and core business; not the AI portion.

statements.quote: In particular, we expect our AI initiatives will require significantly increased investment in infrastructure.
statements.notes: No year named. 'Investment in infrastructure' most likely means capex, but it could include infrastructure operating costs. Kept because it describes the AI part itself, not the total covered by p07.

statements.quote: These efforts include significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products, enhance our advertising tools, develop new products, and develop new features for existing products.
statements.notes: Present tense with no year named. 'These efforts' refers to FoA investments (headcount, data centers, technical infrastructure expenses), so this is treated as opex. The investments could also include capex.

statements.quote: The increase was mostly due to higher employee compensation and infrastructure costs related to research and development, including our AI initiatives.
statements.notes: AI is named as one contributor to the R&D expense increase. The year (2025) and the $13.50 billion appear only in the preceding sentence, which does not mention AI. So the year is left null and no amount is recorded.
